items.docs: The Create Blob operation in the GitHub Repos API allows you to create a new blob object in a repository's Git database by sending a POST request to /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/blobs. A blob (binary large object) represents the content of a file in Git's object database without any metadata like filename or directory structure.
